text.body: namāmi devīṃ kamalāyatākṣīṃ surendrabṛndādi natāṃghriyugmām | samunnatāśeṣasuraprapālinīṃ namāmi durgāṃ duritāpahantrīm || 1 || kirīṭakoṭyullikhitābjapādāṃ manojavāṃ tāṃ parameśabhāminīm | śaśāṃkarekhānvitamastakāgrāṃ sureśvarīṃ tāṃ praṇamāmi durgām || 2 || mūlaśrībhairavātmatrividhapadamahādevatābhiḥ parīte divye siṃhāsanendre sthitamakhilakalābodhakaṃ deśikeśam | tasyāṅke sanniṣaṇṇāmaruṇarucicayā rañjitāśāvakāśāṃ devīmānandapūrṇāmamṛtakaratalāmāśraye'bhīṣṭasiddhyai || 3 || kalpāntānalakoṭikoṭisadṛśaṃ ghoraṃ triśūlāyudhaṃ pāṇibhyāṃ parigṛhya pañcavadanaskandhe'dhiruhya sthitām | viśvāsāvṛtavīraśaktivividhakrīḍāviśeṣāravaiḥ tattatkṣudrasamastaśatrunivahāṃ vande mahāśūlinīm || 4 || bhāsākundaśaśāṅkaśaṃkhasadṛśāṃ kaṇṭhīravādhyāsinīṃ kodāṇḍeṣukapālapustakajapasrak śūladānābhayām | sarveśīṃ nikhilāghasaṃghaśamanīṃ bhaktānukampāparāṃ devīṃ viśvamanorathaikavaradāṃ dhyāyetparāmambikām || 5 || meghaśyāmalakomalāṃ smitamukhīṃ siṃhāsanāṃ śāṅkarīṃ cāpajyodgatavāruṇāstragalitairāpūritāśāṣṭakaiḥ | toyairbhaktaviruddhasainikagaṇaṃ saṃstambhayantyanvahaṃ viśvākāraniyāpanaṃ vidadhatīṃ dhyāyenmahāśūlinīm || 6 || āruhya siṃhamasikheṭarathāṅgaśaṃkhacāpeṣvabhītivaradāṅkuśapāśahastā | pathyagratassakalavairimadāpahaya gacchāniśaṃ vijayaśūlini viśvabhūtyai || 7 || viśvajyotiprakāśe vividhatanumaye viśvahṛtpadmavāse viśvavyāpārabhedānuguṇavividhairviśvaśikṣaikadakṣe | viśvadrohaṃ kṣamasvākhilavidhaduritaṃ nāśayatvāśu śaśvat trāhi śrīśūlinīśe sahajakaruṇayā santataṃ sannidhehi || 8 ||
